hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market pools that implements VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) fees, computed as e^[λ*(Δx/L)*σ]-1 and captured via beforeSwap delta. Every swap requires a cryptographically signed volatility parameter (σ) from a trusted signer encoded in hookData; swaps revert if the market is resolved or disputed.
